from itertools import permutations
rows = data_rows('W1::Allowed assignments', {'L': 'string', 'M': 'string', 'N': 'number'})
data = [(cell('W1::Allowed assignments', f'L{r}'), cell('W1::Allowed assignments', f'M{r}'), num('W1::Allowed assignments', f'N{r}')) for r in rows]
tasks = sorted(list(set(d[0] for d in data)))
workers = sorted(list(set(d[1] for d in data)))
cost_map = {(d[0], d[1]): d[2] for d in data}
min_cost = float('inf')
for w_subset in permutations(workers, len(tasks)):
    c = sum(cost_map.get((t, w), float('inf')) for t, w in zip(tasks, w_subset))
    if c < min_cost:
        min_cost = c
result = min_cost
